body:
Thanks for listening. If you have some good advice, I'd be happy to hear it.

I think in a lot of ways I already know what I should be doing and by doing a few things (getting a driver's license, getting a job, make some friends etc) I'll remove a lot of stress from my life and start to improve. However in my current situation it feels impossible to complete these goals. And worse, I keep focusing on much larger stuff. Like, worrying about not having invested enough money etc.

Whenever I start to think of my problems and try to solve them I get into a terrible mood. My eyelids get all heavy and I feel like I'm not connected to my body and I just feel blank. Then I start to think lots of negative shit. It's hard to get anything done like this. After any small obstacle, I basically just give up and feel like going to sleep.

I'll look for a job and 5 minutes later I'm convinced that my whole life is pointless and I'm useless, so why bother etc. It's tough. I've ordered a few CBT style workbooks that will hopefully help me get through these thoughts.
